"openapi-zod-client generates a Zodios-based TypeScript HTTP client from OpenAPI specs that provides dual-layer protection: compile-time type safety via Zodios type inference from Zod schemas, plus Zod runtime validation of API responses, with no separate type definitions needed."

5. Is this a marketing claim / press release / cherry-picked benchmark / forum speculation?
